Current error rate in payroll-to-ledger reconciliation
research_questions: How many reconciliation breaks occurred in the last 12 months and what caused them?
Can the AFAS extract carry employee-level mutations with restricted access?
Does Rabobank allow a dual approval that fits a code-driven release?

11-3031.01:20169.short: Manage pension, absence, WIA and liability insurance premiums, track rule changes and budget benefit costs.

steps.what: Collect premium notes, renewals and policy changes from insurers and pension fund

loop.input: PDF premium notes and renewal letters from a shared mailbox
loop.output: rows with insurer, policy, period, premium base, rate and amount
loop.check: amount equals base times rate within rounding; policy number exists in the register; failures go to a queue
loop.stop: one extraction plus one retry per document, then manual entry
loop.why_not_simpler: insurers and the pension fund send different PDF layouts with no API

steps.what: Reconcile premiums to AFAS payroll deductions and ledger accounts
Track changes in pension law (Wtp), WIA/WGA, ZW and premium rates

loop.input: new items from Belastingdienst, UWV, pension fund and broker sources
loop.output: short digest with impact on Noordhaven schemes and budget
loop.check: each item links its source; controller or C&B marks relevance
loop.stop: monthly batch, max 20 items, unclear items flagged not summarised
loop.why_not_simpler: the sources are free text and the impact depends on which schemes apply

steps.what: Build benefit and insurance budget from headcount and wage plan
Decide renewals and eigenrisicodrager choice with broker; sign

11-3031.01:20169.design: A shared mailbox feeds a Python job on the governed data platform that extracts premium notes into a premium register, reconciles them nightly against AFAS payroll deductions and ledger accounts, and queues differences. A monthly model digest of UWV, Belastingdienst and pension fund changes goes to the controller and C&B, and the budget is calculated by code from the FP&A headcount plan.
11-3031.01:20169.previous_blocker: Premium notes arrive as PDFs in many layouts and the reconciliation lives in a personal spreadsheet.
11-3031.01:20169.enabler_now: Reliable PDF extraction with checks, and fast coding of the reconciliation on the AFAS extract.
11-3031.01:20169.still_hard: Absence and WIA data are special category data under AVG/GDPR; access must stay aggregated and works-council consent may be needed for new processing of employee data.
11-3031.01:20169.human_edge: Negotiating with the broker, choosing to bear WGA risk or insure it, and weighing employee impact with HR.

ambition.what: A yearly, numbers-based review of eigenrisicodragerschap for WGA and ZW instead of rolling over the policy

11-3031.01:20169.altitude: The controller stops checking premium lines and reviews only exceptions; they gain a clear basis to propose insurance choices to the Finance Director.

reach.learn: Scheme rules and Wtp transition choices that drive cost

evidence.claim: Insurance and benefit summaries suit a model step with human review
Reconciliation and checks belong in deterministic code with a tie-out gate
Model output must be logged for audit

assumptions: Payroll deductions for pension and insurance are booked to separate AFAS ledger accounts
The controller, not C&B, owns premium budgeting
unknowns: Whether Noordhaven is eigenrisicodrager for WGA or ZW
How many insurers and which pension fund(s) apply
Whether the OR must consent under WOR art. 27 to the new processing
research_questions: How many premium differences were found last year and what did they cost?
Can the pension fund and broker deliver premium data in a structured file?
Does the OR see this as a new system processing personal data?

11-3031.01:8860.short: Coordinate the year-end audit and internal checks so accounts meet Dutch law and tax rules.

steps.what: Plan audit with external auditor and agree the request list
Collect evidence: ledger exports, invoices, contracts, bank statements
Run control tests: duplicates, IBAN changes, approvals, segregation of duties
Review exceptions and agree corrections or adjustments
Answer auditor queries and management letter points

loop.input: Auditor query text and linked evidence pack items
loop.output: Draft response with references to evidence files
loop.check: Each reference must resolve to a file in the pack; controller approves before sending
loop.stop: One draft per query; if no evidence found, flag as open item
loop.why_not_simpler: Auditor queries are free text and must be matched to the right evidence.

11-3031.01:8860.design: A scheduled job builds the auditor's request list into an evidence pack from AFAS, SharePoint and Rabobank statements and runs fixed control tests all year (duplicate payments, IBAN changes, approvals over limit, segregation of duties) into a Power BI exception view. A bounded model step drafts responses to auditor queries with file references; the controller decides on adjustments and signs off responses.
11-3031.01:8860.previous_blocker: Evidence gathering and control tests were done once a year by hand because ad-hoc AFAS exports were tedious to repeat.
11-3031.01:8860.enabler_now: AI coding makes repeatable export and test scripts cheap; AFAS bank matching already runs on fixed rules, so tests can focus on what remains.
11-3031.01:8860.still_hard: Dutch GAAP judgements and VAT and wage tax positions are untested for AI drafting; auditors must accept the evidence trail.
11-3031.01:8860.human_edge: Judging materiality and negotiating with the auditor on adjustments and management letter wording.

ambition.what: Monthly control testing instead of once-a-year findings at the audit.

11-3031.01:8860.altitude: Audit season shrinks to review and negotiation; the controller owns the control test set and materiality and gets findings monthly.

reach.task: Supplier master changes and payment runs
reach.learn: Which IBAN-change and duplicate checks block a payment.
How wage tax postings are tested at audit.

evidence.claim: AFAS bank matching uses fixed rules on reference, IBAN and invoice number.
Estimates the auditor cannot rebuild are a known failure when AI work sits in personal accounts.
Tax estimates need mandatory human review and timestamped logs.
Large companies file accounts with KVK via SBR from FY2025, which AFAS cannot do for them.

assumptions: Noordhaven is audited by an external accountant under BW 2 Titel 9.
AFAS authorisation data can be exported.
unknowns: Which audit firm and what evidence format they accept.
Last year's management letter points.
Whether SBR filing is outsourced.
research_questions: Will the auditor rely on automated control test output and evidence packs?
How many hours did last year's audit requests take the finance team?
Which control failures appeared in the last two management letters?

11-3031.01:8874.short: Model tax scenarios on planned investments and results, and agree tax choices with the advisor and finance director.

steps.what: Collect forecast, capex plan and entity results from FP&A and AFAS
Model scenarios: investment deductions, provisions timing, loss carry-forward, fiscal unity
Track Dutch tax rule changes such as the yearly tax plan

loop.input: Advisor newsletters and official tax plan texts collected in a SharePoint folder
loop.output: Short digest of changes relevant to logistics, fleet and warehousing, with source links
loop.check: Each item must cite a source passage; the controller checks items before they change any scenario input
loop.stop: One digest per document batch; items without a source passage are dropped
loop.why_not_simpler: The input is long free text; no rule can pick out what matters for this company

steps.what: Discuss options with tax advisor and finance director
Write the decision memo for the file and the auditor

loop.input: Scenario outputs and meeting notes
loop.output: Draft memo with figures pulled from the scenario model
loop.check: Every figure in the memo is filled from the model, not written by the model; controller edits and approves
loop.stop: One draft; if the notes are incomplete the draft lists open points instead of guessing
loop.why_not_simpler: A template covers the figures, but the reasoning from the meeting is free text

11-3031.01:8874.design: A scenario model in Python on the governed data platform reads the FP&A forecast, capex plan and AFAS actuals, and computes tax outcomes per scenario from versioned rule parameters (rates, deduction brackets). A bounded model step digests rule changes and drafts the decision memo; the controller and advisor make the choices.
11-3031.01:8874.previous_blocker: Tax planning lived in one-off Excel files that copied the forecast, so each run was slow and quickly stale.
11-3031.01:8874.enabler_now: Cheap AI-assisted coding of a parameter-driven model linked to the forecast, and models that summarise long rule texts with citations.
11-3031.01:8874.still_hard: Choosing positions with legal and financial risk, interpreting new rules, and timing decisions with the business.
11-3031.01:8874.human_edge: Weighing tax savings against risk and business plans, and agreeing positions with the advisor and finance director.

ambition.what: Test the tax effect of each major capex request (trucks, forklifts, racking) before approval, not only at year end.

11-3031.01:8874.altitude: The controller runs scenarios in minutes and brings options to capex decisions. They gain a seat in capex approval for the tax angle.

reach.task: Build the forecast and capex plan
reach.learn: Which drivers move taxable profit, so the forecast carries the fields the tax model needs.
Which decisions the board wants tax effects for, and how often.

evidence.claim: Products draft and people approve; teams stay responsible for review.
Tax estimates need mandatory human review and approval with logs.
Benchmarks are US GAAP; Dutch tax rules are untested for models.

assumptions: FP&A keeps a forecast and capex plan in a structured form
The tax advisor stays involved for positions with legal risk
unknowns: How many legal entities and whether a fiscal unity exists
How many capex decisions a year are large enough to need a tax view
Whether the advisor shares rule updates in a form that can be stored
research_questions: How often in the last two years did a tax choice change after the forecast moved?
Can the forecast export capex per asset class and month without manual work?
Would the finance director use a tax view in capex approval?

11-3031.01:8869.short: Answer site managers and budget holders on accounting, budget and spending rules, and steer cost control.

steps.what: Receive and sort questions from budget holders by mail and Teams
Look up policy text and cost-centre budget position
inputs: budget vs actual by cost centre

steps.what: Write the answer or guidance note with the rule and the numbers

loop.input: Question text, retrieved handbook sections, cost-centre budget figures
loop.output: Draft answer citing handbook section and figures, or 'escalate'
loop.check: Every claim must cite a handbook section id; figures are inserted by code, not by the model; controller approves first-of-kind answers
loop.stop: One draft per question, one retry if citation check fails, else route to controller unanswered
loop.why_not_simpler: Questions arrive as free text in varied wording; a fixed FAQ menu does not match them reliably.

steps.what: Advise site managers in budget meetings on cost control and trade-offs
inputs: budget vs actual by cost centre

steps.what: Add recurring answers to the policy FAQ on SharePoint

11-3031.01:8869.design: A Teams intake form replaces loose mails and tags each question with cost centre and topic. A small answer desk on the Microsoft 365 tenant retrieves the finance handbook from SharePoint and pulls budget-vs-actual from the nightly AFAS extract, drafts a cited answer, and the controller approves new kinds of answers; approved ones feed a FAQ.
11-3031.01:8869.previous_blocker: The handbook was scattered across SharePoint files and the controller held the context in their head; retrieval over free-text questions was not reliable enough.
11-3031.01:8869.enabler_now: Retrieval with citations over a small document set works well, and the AFAS extract already exists for Power BI.
11-3031.01:8869.still_hard: Handbook must be kept current and unambiguous; questions that are really negotiations about budget stay human.
11-3031.01:8869.human_edge: Knowing when a site manager needs a firm no versus room to act, and building the trust that makes budget holders follow the rules.

ambition.what: Team leads in Tilburg and Venlo warehouses with small spending authority get same-day answers on what they may spend.

11-3031.01:8869.altitude: Fewer interruptions; the controller spends time in budget conversations and owns the handbook and the answer approval rules.

reach.task: Budget vs actual reporting per cost centre
reach.learn: Which budget questions repeat, to improve the forecast and dashboard.

evidence.claim: Retrieval-based answer desks with citations over a policy set are a standard pattern.
Prompts and outputs must live in a governed place, not a personal account, so answers can be rebuilt later.

assumptions: The finance handbook exists on SharePoint in some form.
Cost-centre budgets are loaded in AFAS or the Power BI model.
unknowns: How many questions per month reach the controller and from whom.
Whether budget figures are visible to site managers today.
research_questions: What share of last quarter's questions to the controller could be answered from the handbook alone?
Do budget holders accept a drafted answer if it cites the rule?
Is the handbook complete enough to answer the top 20 questions?

11-3031.01:8875.short: Set depreciation on new assets and advise management on buying, leasing or disposing of trucks, forklifts and racking.

steps.what: Pick up capex invoices and classify them into asset classes

loop.input: Invoice lines booked on capex or high-value cost accounts, with description and amount
loop.output: Proposed asset class, capitalise or expense, and reason
loop.check: Amount above the capitalisation threshold; asset class exists in the policy table; totals tie to the AP booking; low confidence goes to the controller
loop.stop: One pass per line, two retries on invalid output, then manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Invoice descriptions vary by supplier, and splitting capex from repairs needs reading the text

steps.what: Set useful life and residual value per asset by policy
Run monthly depreciation in AFAS and check it ties to the ledger
Analyse buy, lease or dispose options with cost and usage data
Advise management in a memo or meeting

11-3031.01:8875.design: Configure AFAS fixed assets with a maintained asset policy table so useful lives and monthly depreciation run without Excel. A bounded model step proposes capitalise-or-expense and asset class for invoice lines, and a deterministic lease-versus-buy calculator on the data platform reads asset register, maintenance costs and offers to produce a standard analysis for management.
11-3031.01:8875.previous_blocker: Capex invoices arrive with varied descriptions, and the lease-buy analysis was rebuilt in Excel for each request.
11-3031.01:8875.enabler_now: Models can read invoice descriptions under a tie-out check, and a standard calculator is cheap to build with AI-assisted coding.
11-3031.01:8875.still_hard: Judging useful life for unusual assets, impairment, and the operational trade-offs of fleet choices.
11-3031.01:8875.human_edge: The controller weighs operational needs, financing and risk with site managers and the finance director, and owns the depreciation policy.

ambition.what: A standard lease-buy-dispose check for every truck, forklift and racking request from the three sites.

11-3031.01:8875.altitude: The controller reviews exceptions instead of coding every addition, and spends the time on fleet and equipment advice. They gain a formal advisory role in site capex requests.

reach.learn: Which invoice lines are capex, so they are flagged at entry.
How planned assets flow into depreciation forecasts.

evidence.claim: Products draft entries and people review and approve them before posting.
Posting should wait until a deterministic tie-out passes.
AFAS Profit has a fixed asset module that runs depreciation per asset.

assumptions: The AFAS fixed asset module is licensed or can be added
Leases are handled under Dutch GAAP, not IFRS 16
unknowns: How many capex invoices arrive per year
Whether depreciation already runs in AFAS or in Excel
Who owns fleet decisions at site level
research_questions: What share of capex invoices is misclassified today and found at the audit?
Is the AFAS fixed asset module in use and configured per asset class?
Would site managers use a standard lease-buy check before requesting equipment?
